nodes.title: Oversize Fleeced Hoodie
nodes.descriptionHtml:
An oversized fleece hoodie with a loose fit, dropped shoulders and long sleeves. An easy layer for cooler days, styled with jeans or joggers.

Features

- Fit: Loose
- Neckline: Hooded
- Sleeve Style: Drop Shoulder
- Sleeve Length: Long Sleeve
- Season: Autumn / Winter
- Style: Casual / Street

Care Instructions

- Machine wash at 30°C (gentle cycle)
- Do not bleach
- Tumble dry low
- Iron at low temperature, avoid ironing on print
- Do not dry clean

Fabric

- Material: 42% cotton, 53% polyester, 5% other fibers
- Fabric Weight: 350 gsm (10.3 oz)
